question: What is the meaning of recycled content in relation to sustainability properties?
description: The recycled content in relation to sustainability properties refers to the mass of waste from recycled feedstock, denoted as WF in the Linear Flow Index (LFI) and Material Circularity Indicator (MCI) calculations. This component is crucial for assessing the sustainability of a material or product by quantifying the amount of waste that is effectively reused, thus contributing to a more circular economy.
